terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use and Sale
terms.subtitle: Rules for using the platform and the legal framework for investments.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: These Terms and Conditions govern access to and use of the real estate crowdfunding platform operated by {{companyName}}. By using our services, you accept these Terms and Conditions without reservation.

sections.title: 2. Access to services
paragraphs: Access to investment projects requires creating a user account and, when required by the platform, providing valid identity documents (KYC - Know Your Customer process), in accordance with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing legislation (AML-CFT). A project owner cannot invest in their own project. To invest or submit a project, the account's email address must have been confirmed through the link sent at sign-up.
after: Project owners: the owner provides accurate, up-to-date documents (verification of the company and the operation). A project may be rejected with a reason, or be subject to a request for additional information. Once the project is funded, the owner regularly informs investors of its progress through updates, which may be reviewed by {{companyName}} before publication.

sections.title: 3. Payments and protection of funds
paragraphs: Online payments are processed by licensed providers: CinetPay, Wave, PayDunya and Flutterwave (Mobile Money, e-wallets and cards), and Stripe (international cards). Depending on the payment method chosen, the platform automatically selects an available provider; investors may also indicate a preferred provider. When offered, a bank or manual money transfer is also possible: the investment is then validated by our team once the funds are received.

An investment is only validated after the payment has been confirmed directly with the provider, for an amount and currency identical to those of the subscription. A payment not completed within {{expiryHours}} hours expires and the corresponding investment is cancelled, free of charge. The minimum subscription amount is the one shown on each project page, up to the amount still to be raised and, where applicable, the per-investment cap set by the platform.

Before each investment, the investor expressly accepts these terms and the risk warning; the date of this acceptance is recorded. Invested funds are held in a dedicated account until the fundraising closes. If the fundraising target is not reached or the project is cancelled, investors are refunded in full at no additional cost. A payment received twice is refunded. Each project has a fundraising deadline, shown on its page. On that date, if the amount raised reaches {{threshold}}% of the target, the fundraising succeeds; otherwise the project is declared not funded: pending investments are cancelled and paid investments are refunded in full, at no cost, the investor being informed by email when the refund starts and when it is completed. Investors have a withdrawal period, whose length is shown in each project's key investment information and in the investment window: during this period, and as long as the fundraising is not closed, they can cancel their investment from their account, at no cost and without justification; the amount paid, fees included, is then refunded in full.
after: Income and repayments: amounts paid by a project (rental income, interest, capital repayment) are split among its investors pro rata to their validated investments, rounded to the franc, and paid by {{companyName}} to the payout details given in “My profile”. Each payout is notified and appears in the portfolio and the annual statement. Declaring the income received for tax purposes is the investor's responsibility.

sections.title: 4. Fees
items: Investors: entry fee of {{investorFee}}% of the amount invested, added to the amount paid and shown before confirmation (0% = no fee).
Project owners: application fee of {{submissionFee}} and a commission of {{commission}}% of the funds raised, deducted when the fundraising closes.
The applicable fees are those in force on the date of the investment or application.

sections.title: 5. Risk warning
paragraphs: Real estate investment and crowdfunding carry inherent risks:
items: Risk of capital loss: you may lose all or part of the funds invested.
Illiquidity risk: investments are locked in for the duration of the project (generally 12 to 36 months). It is very difficult, or even impossible, to sell your shares before maturity.
Return: a "fixed" return is contractual; a "target" return is an objective that is not guaranteed.

Investor profile: before investing, users answer a short questionnaire about their understanding of the risks and their ability to bear a loss (to be renewed every {{investorProfileValidityMonths}} months). If the result shows the investment is particularly risky for them, a stronger warning is shown and must be accepted before each investment. This questionnaire does not constitute investment advice.
after: We advise you never to invest money you may need in the short term and to diversify your investments.

sections.title: 6. Communications
paragraphs: Emails about the account, payments and investments are always sent. Other communications (support replies by email, notices to project owners, newsletter) can be set in "My profile". Group messages from the team appear in your notification centre and, depending on your preferences, by email.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual property
paragraphs: All content on the platform (texts, images, logos, architecture) is protected by copyright. Any unauthorised reproduction is strictly prohibited.

sections.title: 8. Referrals
paragraphs: When the referral programme is open, each user has a personal code and link. The current benefits (referrer reward, referee reward, referee entry-fee discount) and their conditions are shown in the user's account; they may be changed or suspended for the future.
items: Benefits are granted only once per referee, on the referee's first validated investment, possibly above a minimum amount.
Rewards are paid by Emeraude Africa to the beneficiary's payout details; a reward not yet paid is cancelled if the investment that triggered it is withdrawn (cooling-off, rejection or refund).
Self-referral, fake accounts or any scheme aimed at obtaining a benefit improperly lead to the cancellation of the benefits concerned.
Beneficiaries are responsible for declaring any rewards received to the tax authorities of their country of residence, where applicable.

sections.title: 9. Auto-invest
paragraphs: Investors may save criteria (amount, minimum target return, maximum duration, asset types, monthly cap). For each project opening for funding that matches them, they receive a proposal. No amount is reserved or charged automatically: each proposal must be confirmed and paid by the investor, under the same conditions as any investment (identity check, investor profile, acceptance of these terms). A proposal is not investment advice; criteria can be changed or turned off at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: Protecting your personal data and respecting your privacy.

sections.title: 1. Data collected
paragraphs: When you sign up, invest and contact us, {{companyName}} collects the following data:
items: Identification data: last name, first name, email address, phone number. Date on which the email address was confirmed.

Legal documents (ID document, proof of address) as part of our verification obligations (KYC). They are stored with restricted access and can only be viewed by our compliance team, through temporary links.

Project owners: file documents (articles of association, trade register extract, tax number, director's ID, land titles, permits, financing plan), stored with restricted access and only reviewed by our team through temporary links, as well as messages with the team about the project.

Investor profile: your answers to the knowledge and loss-capacity questionnaire, their result and date. They are only used to tailor risk warnings and are never shared with third parties. The reason your ID documents were rejected, if applicable. Notifications in your dashboard (the latest 100 at most).

Payout details: the method chosen (Mobile Money or bank transfer) and the related details (number, account holder, bank, IBAN or account number), used only to pay you income and repayments. History of payouts received.

Transaction data: investment history, chosen payment method, provider used, payment references and statuses, and a time-stamped log of exchanges with that provider (traceability and fraud prevention). We never store your card numbers or Mobile Money codes: they are entered directly with our payment providers (CinetPay, Wave, PayDunya, Flutterwave, Stripe).
Proof of consent: date and time you accepted these terms when signing up, and the Terms and Conditions of Sale before each investment.
Preferences: language and communication choices (optional emails, newsletter), editable at any time in "My profile".

Referrals: the link between referrer and referee, referral code and rewards. Referrers only see their referees' first name and last-name initial and whether they have invested (never the amounts); referees see their referrer's first name and initial.
Auto-invest: saved criteria (amount, return, duration, asset types, cap) and proposals received.
Contact form and newsletter: name, email address, phone (optional), message content, page of origin and date of your consent.
Audience measurement: pages viewed and technical information about your browser, only if you accepted it in the cookie banner.

Security and traceability: if you turn on two-factor authentication, your app key is stored encrypted and recovery codes as fingerprints only. Team actions on accounts and transactions, as well as administrator sign-ins, are recorded in an audit log (author, date, IP address), kept for the platform's security and to meet our obligations.

sections.title: 2. Purposes of processing
paragraphs: Your data is used exclusively to:
items: Manage your account and investments.
Generate your legal and tax certificates.
Answer your requests and, if you agreed, send you our newsletter.
Improve the site with traffic statistics, if you agreed.
Comply with legal obligations (fraud and money laundering prevention).

sections.title: 3. Data sharing
paragraphs: Your personal information is never sold to third parties for commercial purposes. It may only be shared with the competent authorities in the event of a legal requisition, and with the payment provider used for your transaction (CinetPay, Wave, PayDunya, Flutterwave or Stripe): last name, first name, email address, phone, amount and transaction reference, only to the extent necessary to process it. Our technical subcontractors (hosting, email delivery, file storage, audience measurement) only access it to provide their service. Some of these providers may process data outside your country of residence, with security safeguards consistent with their regulatory obligations.

sections.title: 4. Retention period
paragraphs: In accordance with financial regulations, account and transaction data is kept for the entire duration of the business relationship, then archived for 5 years for traceability and evidence purposes. Contact requests are kept for 3 years after the last exchange. Newsletter subscriptions are kept until you unsubscribe. Your cookie choice is kept for 6 months.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
paragraphs: The site uses storage strictly necessary for it to work (keeping you signed in). Audience measurement cookies are only set after your consent; you can change your choice at any time via the "Manage cookies" link at the bottom of the page.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: Under data protection laws (in particular Senegalese law no. 2008-12 and the GDPR for European residents), you have the right to access, rectify, erase, object to and port your data, and the right to withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise these rights, contact: {{privacyEmail}}.

why.title: Why Emeraude Africa?
why.subtitle: A platform designed for investing in African real estate, from Africa and from the diaspora.

reasons.title: Accessible
reasons.desc: Invest from the minimum ticket set for each project, without having to buy a whole property.

reasons.title: Local payments
reasons.desc: Mobile Money, Wave or bank card through licensed providers (CinetPay, PayDunya, Flutterwave, Stripe), or by bank transfer.

reasons.title: Vetted projects
reasons.desc: Every submitted project is reviewed by our team before publication: documents, owner identity, guarantees and financial structure.

reasons.title: Transparency
reasons.desc: Amount raised updated in real time, project documents, tracking of your investments and certificates in your account.

reasons.title: Security
reasons.desc: Verified identity for every investor, payments confirmed directly with the provider, ID documents stored with restricted access.

reasons.title: Built for the diaspora
reasons.desc: Site in French and English, payment by international card or transfer: invest in your home country, wherever you live.
